svg.title: Competitions, newest first. Optiver AI Chessathon 2026: 2nd of 465 teams in the qualifier as a solo entry, then 5th in the London final. IMC Prosperity: 3rd in the UK in 2024, then 4th in the UK in 2025. ICHack 2024: Best Newcomer Hack with map.it, and runner-up for Citadel's Most Innovative Use of Financial Data.
